text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a walk with Oguri Cap during our lunch break, but she doesn't seem to have much energy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sorry… Lately, no matter how much I sleep or eat, I always seem to be out of energy…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Maybe I need to eat more… Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All those consecutive races must have taken their toll. I should probably adjust her schedule to avoid any further problems.
